{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Premiere &ndash; Hoth''' (display name '''Premiere - Hoth'''; GEMP code <code>premiere_hoth</code>) is a constructed environment whose legal pool is the printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Hoth]].

Decipher Deck Designs from early 1997 (through April, before [[Dagobah]]) used this pool. On [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] the same environment is <code>premiere_hoth</code> (set ids 1&ndash;3 plus premium ids 101&ndash;104).
